name: Lyndaria: Lust Adventure
source:
🌴 [b]Mysterious and uncharted island in the Atlantic Ocean.[/b] A piece of land that neither ships nor the ubiquitous satellites have found. But one man did. Adam Grant was able to reach the island and gave it a name - Lyndaria!

Ten years later, his daughter Maya arrives on the island to finally find her father, but she has no idea what [b]sexual adventures await her at every corner[/b]! 🍌

Here pristine nature is breathtaking in its splendour, mysterious tribes live in harmony with it, and gods and spirits walk among mortals. [b]Brave and naive young explorer Maya is enchanted by the marvellous island, but she has yet to see its dark side...[/b]

In her search for her missing father, Maya is forced to intervene in conflicts between tribes. She will have to become a cunning seductress, a wise healer, a skilful hunter or a fearless warrior to unravel the mystery of the enigmatic island.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
🌴 [b]大西洋上神秘而未知的岛屿。[/b] 一块无论是船只还是无处不在的卫星都没有发现的土地。但有一个人做到了。亚当·格兰特（Adam Grant）到达了这座岛，并给它起了个名字——林达里亚（Lyndaria）！

十年后，他的女儿玛雅来到岛上，终于找到了她的父亲，但她不知道每个角落都有什么[b]性冒险[/b]！🍌

这里原始的自然风光令人叹为观止，神秘的部落与之和谐相处，神灵行走在凡人之中。[b]勇敢而天真的年轻探险家玛雅被这个奇妙的岛屿迷住了，但她还没有看到它的阴暗面……[/b]

在寻找失踪父亲的过程中，玛雅被迫介入部落之间的冲突。她必须成为一个狡猾的诱惑者、一个明智的治疗师、一个熟练的猎人或一个无所畏惧的战士，才能解开这座神秘岛屿的谜团。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781250/]Steam[/url]]
